svg.title: Solaris component inventory
svg.text: Component inventory · launcher/web (left) and in game (right, GUI scale 3)
Danger = red text + red edge; never red fill. Confirms with consequence.
One primary per decision region. Busy keeps width; label says what is happening.
Only universal tools. Never a word squeezed
R e c i p e s
well fill · 1 px edge · amber when focused
named stages · bytes only when known
Unpacking assets — no percentage, no sweeping bar
persistent until resolved · left bar + icon + words
Could not reach the Solaris content server
Server uses a different game version
Toast (bottom-left, 5 s, pausable) only for reversible confirmations like this one.
Selected = 3 px amber bar + ink3. Status = icon + words. Numbers in tables are right-aligned mono.
vanilla rhythm · 20 px controls · notch 1 GUI px
Vanilla screens (inventory, containers, recipe book, hotbar, chat) are not in this inventory: they keep vanilla sprites.
The red sample at left shows the anti-pattern: a word squeezed into a tiny tab where an icon belongs.
